actions.notes: Binary only, no implicit Google Workspace conversion. Read artifact owned by actor/space, pin SHA256+size, generate remote file ID, resumable initiation/chunks/status, 256KiB multiples; max10MiB. Lost initiation ACK stops; lost chunk ACK queries same session, never creates replacement file. Zero-byte new files use metadata-only create; explicit zero-byte replacements use PATCH uploadType=media with empty bytes and exact size/checksum acknowledgement.
